verified.source: on-chain reading on https://bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org: symbol, decimals, proxy slots (scratchpad/a320/onchain-*.txt)
Circle lists no USDC on BNB Smart Chain (same page); this is the Binance-Peg token, owner decision pending. Binance's collateral page could not be read by a script

unit.note: contracts/evmnets/ScaledUnitToken.sol: fixed rate, no fee, no owner

fee.collection: accrued in the vault outside the backing; anyone calls sweepFees() and the vault pays the recipient in unit tokens, which the recipient unwraps
fee.networkFee: the depositor pays the deposit transaction; the relayer pays the release transaction

finality.rule: A deposit is attested when its block is at or below the block the signer's own BNB Smart Chain node reports as finalized (fast finality, two more blocks voted by two thirds of the validators) and at least 135 more blocks below it.
finality.reorg: Signers read only finalized blocks; a deposit that leaves the canonical chain before finality is never attested. Every mint waits 12 hours on the L2; the relayer does not execute a mint whose deposit is not in the vault's finalized deposit chain and the guardians cancel it. A credited mint with no deposit holds later releases instead of paying them.

deposit.recipientEncoding: bytes32: the 20-byte L2 address left-padded with zeros
deposit.function: wrapAndDeposit(address vault, uint64 amount, bytes32 l2Recipient) on asset.unit.adapter
steps: approve the unit token (asset.unit.adapter) for amount x 1000000000000 on the asset contract
call wrapAndDeposit(vault, amount, l2Recipient) on the unit token; amount is in 6-decimal units
after source finality and the 12 hour mint delay the L2 token credits amount less 0.05% to l2Recipient
refusals: an amount below minDeposit or above maxDeposit, or one that would pass the cap
an l2Recipient that is zero or longer than 20 bytes
do not name a contract as l2Recipient unless it can move the token

release.paysAsset: unit tokens (6 decimals), the burned amount less 0.05%; the recipient calls unwrap(to, units) on the unit token to receive Binance-Peg USD Coin
notes: the recipient must be able to call unwrap: do not name a contract that cannot

the page must send unwrap(to, units) for the user right after the release is paid, or show it as a required second step with the unit balance; a recipient that is an exchange deposit address or a contract that cannot call unwrap must be refused by the page
NOT IN V1 - OWNER DECISION: the recommendation is to leave this network out of v1. A page must not offer it unless the owner decides otherwise.
UNAUDITED. Nothing is deployed. Limits are the Ethereum bridge's launch values, proposed for this network; the owner confirms them before deployment.

Releases on this network need the five signers and the relayer to finish within about 115 s of each other (256 blocks); operators run the daemons at a 5 second interval here. If a round misses the window nothing is paid and it is repeated.
